verification_questions.question: Migration 036 partial UNIQUE INDEX guard lookup degisikligi pg_constraint -> pg_class re-run safety saglar mi? Postgres'te partial UNIQUE INDEX (WHERE clause'lu) gercekten pg_constraint'te gorulmuyor mu?
verification_questions.codex_answer: Evet. Postgres docs: 'Predicates with WHERE clauses can be implemented as partial indexes only, NOT as constraints' — pg_constraint sadece tablo-level CHECK/UNIQUE/FK/PK constraint'leri tutar. Partial UNIQUE INDEX pg_class (relkind='i' index) icinde. Onceki kod IF NOT EXISTS pg_constraint check her zaman TRUE doner, CREATE her zaman calismaya calisir, ikinci run 'relation already exists' patlatir. pg_class WHERE relname AND relkind='i' dogru lookup.
